notes: ESP32-C3: 3 or 4 LED outputs all sent together over SPI (no more frozen LEDs with Bluetooth); zones kept after a restart even when the app is reading at start-up
LED outputs: a button or movement sensor on an LED pin is moved off it (GPIO 0), one output that cannot start no longer stops the others, and the app says which pin is taken
Test mode for LED outputs: a 3rd output on the ESP32-C3 (up to 8 on the ESP32) and a warning for risky pins
